subject: ❌ Cancelled: $event_name
body:
Dear $student_name,

We are sorry to tell you that an event you registered for has been cancelled.

=== THE CANCELLED EVENT ===
Event: $event_name
Was Taking Place: $start_datetime
Location: $location
Organiser: $organizer_name
Cancelled On: $cancelled_date
Cancelled By: $cancelled_by

=== WHY ===
$reason

=== WHAT THIS MEANS FOR YOU ===
- Your registration has been cancelled. You do not need to do anything.
- Please do not turn up at the venue — the event is not going ahead.
- If you paid for a ticket, a refund will be processed automatically. Contact us if it has not appeared within 10 working days.

=== OTHER EVENTS ===
There are other events coming up — browse them under Events → View Upcoming Events.

=== CONTACT ===
Students' Union Events: studentunion@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567
Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM

We are sorry for the inconvenience.

Best regards,
Students' Union Events Team

$signature
